source.title: Top navigation tabs (Workflows / Agents / Credentials...) jitter in Safari, fine in Edge(Chrome) (2.46.x)

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

The top navigation tabs on the Overview page (Workflows / Agents (Preview) / Credentials / Executions / Variables / Data tables) jitter (shake horizontally) in Safari on macOS.
also reproduces in a private window

- Happens at 100% browser zoom.
- At other zoom levels it usually does not happen, but the tab bar can still break while the window is being resized to a narrower width.
- Reproduces on two different Macs (Mac mini M4 and MacBook Air 15" M5) with Safari 26.5.
- Does NOT happen on Chrome (macOS, same window size) or on iPad Safari (same instance).
- The "Show scroll bars" macOS setting makes no difference.

It looks like the tab bar keeps re-evaluating its overflow/truncation state near a width threshold. I suspect it may be related to the tab overflow / Preview badge layout change (DS-681, PR #41567, merged Oct 21, 2026), since it is in the same area, but I have not verified this in the code.

A screen recording is attached below.
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/622525ec-7866-4b5e-980d-97c329e33b3f



### To Reproduce

1. Open n8n 2.46.4 in Safari 26.5 on macOS.
2. Go to the Overview page (the page with the Workflows / Agents / Credentials / Executions / Variables / Data tables tabs).
3. Keep browser zoom at 100% with a normal window width: the tab bar jitters.
4. At a non-100% zoom, drag the window edge to make it narrower: at some widths the tab bar jitters or breaks.
5. Open the same page in Chrome (same window size) or on iPad Safari: no jitter.

### Expected behavior

The tab bar stays stable at any window width and zoom level, as it does in Chrome and on iPad Safari.

comments.text: This looks like a regression: I did not notice it on 2.44.7. I believe it started with the 2.45.x line, which included a tab overflow / Preview badge layout change (DS-681, PR #41567), and it is still present in 2.46.4.
